claim:particle-colony.proposition: An agent-based colony — particles each carrying their own flux-balance metabolism, moving by Brownian motion through a diffusing field — grows in biomass and proliferates by division.

narrative.question: When each cell is an explicit particle carrying its own flux-balance metabolism, moving by Brownian motion through a diffusing nutrient field, does the population grow in biomass and proliferate by division into a colony?

units.proposition: An agent-based colony — particles each carrying their own flux-balance metabolism, moving by Brownian motion through a diffusing field — grows in biomass and proliferates by division.
